executiveBrief: Apollo's CTO is a technically rigorous decision-maker whose primary concern is integration feasibility and data sovereignty. The highest-probability path to a pilot is leading with the pre-built Astreya connector, directly addressing the in-house build team dynamic, and offering a zero-cost 30-day PoC that bypasses procurement delays entirely.

conversationFlow.approach: Acknowledge the Astreya integration challenge directly. Open by showing the connector live on a test instance — remove the 'can it actually connect?' uncertainty in the first 3 minutes.

Confirm the current documentation time burden with data. Ask about the in-house build team's roadmap and quantify their build cost vs. our deployment cost. Surface the data sovereignty requirement explicitly.
Live demo on the Astreya test instance showing the 40% documentation reduction metric. Reference a comparable Indian hospital chain by name. Show the on-premise deployment architecture diagram.
Address the in-house build objection with the build cost analysis. Show the security architecture for data sovereignty. Present the previous failed pilot post-mortem comparison to our PoC structure.
Propose a zero-cost 30-day PoC at one hospital. Ask the CTO to define 3 success criteria with you right now. Schedule the IT team technical deep-dive before leaving the room.

topQuestions: What is the current status of your in-house automation roadmap on Astreya, and how many engineers are allocated to it?
Which 3 hospitals would you consider for a controlled pilot — and what would make it an unambiguous success?
What does your data sovereignty requirement look like in practice — on-premise only, private cloud, or hybrid?

objectionResponses.objection: We already have an in-house team building on Astreya
objectionResponses.response: Our connector took 18 months and a 6-person team to build. We deploy in 2 weeks. We can show you a detailed build vs. buy cost analysis. Your team's time is better invested in clinical innovation.
We support fully air-gapped on-premise deployment. Three current clients operate under identical compliance constraints. We can share our security architecture and arrange a CISO-level call today.

objectionResponses.objection: We had a failed pilot with another vendor
objectionResponses.response: 30-day PoC with contractual outcome SLAs — we absorb the delivery risk. You define the success criteria. No procurement approval required to start.
Zero-cost PoC starts immediately with no procurement. Formal procurement runs in parallel with the extended pilot once results are proven.

nextSteps: Share the Astreya connector technical specification document within 24 hours
Schedule a 1-hour technical deep-dive with CTO and IT team lead within 1 week
Define 3 measurable PoC success criteria and select pilot hospital together in that session
